name: learn-with-claude
description: Turn coding agents into tutors: they build, critique, and quiz you in parallel so you remember what changed.

scripts.demo: rm -rf ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/learn-demo && LEARN_HOME=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/learn-demo LEARN_PORT=4499 node mcp/cli.js dashboard & sleep 1 && LEARN_HOME=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/learn-demo node test/seed-demo.js --live --history; wait

author: Khalid Baba
